title: 数据清点与来源审计
question: 两份选段和外部 NPZ 包含什么；CI16 导出是否可追溯？
inputs: 本地 selected IQ 快照；完整外部库未复制。
methods: NPZ 清点、复数样点解释、CI16 导出、来源和早期编号审计。
controls_and_limits: 历史编号审计不是空口编号解码；全库清点仍依赖外部源。
parameters_and_seeds: Retained in source/results; missing historical settings are not invented.
reproducibility_limits: Some historical results were produced interactively without standalone scripts. Classification is not a full independent rerun.
